items.gloss: ʿAmra picked up the fallen banner and raised it for Quraysh.

items.gloss: Ziyād b. al-Sakan stood with five Anṣār to fight before the Prophet.

items.gloss: Qatāda b. al-Nuʿmān's eye was struck that day.

items.gloss: Anas b. al-Naḍr fought until he was killed.

items.gloss: Anas b. al-Naḍr was killed.

items.gloss: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf was wounded that day.

items.gloss: Kaʿb b. Mālik recognised the Prophet's eyes.

items.subject: Ṭalḥa b. ʿUbaydullāh
items.gloss: Ṭalḥa was with the Prophet.

items.subject: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
items.gloss: ʿUmar was with the Prophet.

items.gloss: al-Zubayr was with the Prophet.

items.gloss: Abū Bakr was with the Prophet.

items.subject: ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib
items.gloss: ʿAlī was with the Prophet.

items.subject: al-Ḥārith b. al-Ṣimma
items.gloss: al-Ḥārith b. al-Ṣimma was with the Prophet.

items.subject: Ubayy b. Khalaf
items.gloss: Ubayy died at Sarif on the way back to Makkah.

items.subject: Khalid b. al-Walid
items.gloss: Khālid b. al-Walīd led the cavalry that climbed the mountain.

items.subject: Ṭalḥa b. ʿUbaydullāh
items.gloss: Ṭalḥa sat under the Prophet and lifted him onto the rock.

items.subject: Thābit b. Waqsh

items.subject: Thābit b. Waqsh

items.gloss: Ḥusayl was killed by the Muslims' swords, unrecognised.

items.subject: Yazīd b. Ḥāṭib
items.gloss: Yazīd b. Ḥāṭib was wounded at Uḥud.

items.gloss: Quzmān killed himself with an arrow after being wounded.

items.subject: Quzmān
items.gloss: Quzmān fought fiercely at Uḥud.

items.subject: Mukhayrīq (Jewish convert killed at Uḥud)
items.gloss: Mukhayrīq was among those killed at Uḥud.

items.gloss: al-Uṣayrim died of his wounds.

items.subject: Amr ibn al-Jamuh
items.gloss: ʿAmr b. al-Jamūḥ was killed at Uḥud.

items.gloss: Hind and the women with her mutilated the Muslim dead.

items.subject: al-Ḥulays b. Zabbān
items.gloss: al-Ḥulays passed Abū Sufyān as he struck Ḥamza's jaw.

items.subject: Sa'd ibn al-Rabi'
items.gloss: Saʿd b. al-Rabīʿ was killed as a martyr at Uḥud.

items.subject: Muṣʿab b. ʿUmayr
items.gloss: Muṣʿab's death was announced to Ḥamna.

items.gloss: ʿAlī gave his bloodied sword to Fāṭima.

items.subject: Abu Dujana (Simak b. Kharasha)
items.gloss: Abū Dujāna fought truly at Uḥud.

items.subject: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr
items.gloss: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr is listed among those who died at Uḥud.

items.subject: Mālik b. Numayla
items.gloss: Mālik b. Numayla is listed among those who died at Uḥud.

items.gloss: Ḥassān mourns Ḥamza and the Companions struck down at Uḥud.

items.gloss: ʿUthmān b. Abī Ṭalḥa was killed at Uḥud.

items.gloss: The Prophet led this expedition in person (among the twenty-seven he campaigned in).
